data.description:
## Context
Recent GitHub Actions runs have remained stuck until another session manually cleared them. Diagnose the recurring cause using authenticated GitHub evidence without mutating workflow or run state.

## Plan
- Inspect recent Actions runs, jobs, queue/concurrency metadata, cancellation history, and workflow definitions.
- Correlate the stuck runs with triggering events, reusable-workflow structure, runner labels, concurrency groups, and repository limits.
- Distinguish the immediate clearing action from the systemic root cause and record evidence-backed remediation options.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The affected run or run pattern is identified with URLs and timestamps.
- [ ] The mechanism that leaves runs stuck is explained from GitHub API and workflow evidence.
- [ ] Competing hypotheses are checked and uncertainty is stated.
- [ ] Findings and a focused remediation recommendation are recorded on this ticket.

## File impact
Read-only diagnosis; no repository files will be modified.
data.title: Diagnose stuck GitHub Actions runs
